note: The suite language is the kernel command schema. Do not add a second apply/query/explain.

customer_intent.evidence: ordered-quantity / requested-delivery claims exist; no separate intent then AcceptOrder

commercial_commitment.evidence: committed-purchase-quantity after purchase; not a commercial commitment Type

procurement_need.evidence: purchase is the procurement Action; no reserve-then-shortage split

accounting_consequence.needed: receivable/settlement as claims or occurrences after fulfillment, through CommitOperation

human_and_agent_same_action.needed: same action_id, two attributions (human workload vs agent workload) both CommitOperation

ontology_revision_mid_cycle.needed: InstallDefinitionRevision after a committed Action; explain still pins the old revision

no_second_authority.evidence: mutations go through CommitOperation; verify.py forbids domain branches

correction_not_mutation.needed: return/credit as a new record that does not rewrite the original occurrence
